reports.desc: Identified ad on facebook.  Helping a Disabled Veteran.  Checked out the website: BBB A+, Veteran certified, claiming to be Handmade out of horseshoes, pictures of Jordan Maynard, Supporting US Disabled Vets,  looks perfectly legit.  Ordered 2 chimes, never received after almost a month, inquired customer support (86+ country number China), received 2 bogus USPS tracking #s, finally received product, they are junk, not handmade, not of horseshoe material (probable 3D printed), string to hold, not leather as pictured.  Requested refund and will only give 30%.  It's a hoax using a disabled US Military Veteran as the ploy. maynardhandmade.com  (purchase worry free)  BS

reports.desc: I ordered a set of shorts that were supposedly being cleared out.  After a few weeks, I inquired and was sent a tracking number.  The tracking number is bogus and leads to Tracy718, but it does not give any results.  It just buffers and then says unavailable.  I've emailed probably 15 different times, and I'm now being told they need to keep 15.99 because the logistics company won't refund it.  They still won't refund the remaining balance of 10.00.  It's an endless loop of dead-end emails.

I receive a delivery confirmation email, but the items purchased/expected did not arrive. Several attempts were made to get location information of the delivery.
Two days before, I received a small manila bubble envelope delivered via USPS to home mailbox. Inside were two purple cross charms. Baffled, I did a Google search on the shipper's address. Here's what I learned.
 
SHIPPING DEPARTMENT
STE 313
20 HAYPRESS RD
CRANDBURY, NJ 08512-3421
 
This address is heavily linked to online purchase scams (such as bait-and-switch orders) and "brushing" scams. Unfortunately, I had no clue the Purple Crosses were related and they were tossed out.
